title: Boundary: VideoML is renderer; no VideoJob type; Publicist does not see jobs
description:
Parked boundary — do not implement. Not a type. Not in progress.

VideoML is the renderer for Deliverable `kind=Video`. There is **no VideoJob type**. Render status is a field/state on the Deliverable. Publicist should not see jobs.

File stays on Babulus (not a VideoML code change). VideoML does not grow Campaign / Slot / Post types.

No implementation from this issue.

Ported from develop board, old ID babs-0b62483c-27b4-43ba-a4ee-a54617ced583
